The evidence states that the authors look to the trend of providing eye tracking to displays as seen in technologies such as foveated rendering [Guenter et al. 2012]. It then describes a specific method (reducing sub-hologram width) suggested by the authors themselves ('we suggest...'). It attributes a different method (reducing density of object points) to Hong et al. [2016]. The text does not attribute the specific concept of 'reducing resolution outside the fovea' (specifically via sub-hologram width or general resolution reduction in this context) to Guenter et al.; rather, it cites Guenter et al. as an example of the general trend of eye-tracked displays/foveated rendering.
